title: Co-founder & CEO
segment: Brain foundation model + non-invasive EEG wearable (brain-AI interface)
top_signal: Raised $50M seed led by Khosla (with Accel, DST Global, Initialized) to expand its neural dataset beyond 100,000 hours and keep training its Brain Foundation Model; CES 2027 prototype
contact_source: press release Oct 2026 + Boing Boing/Lets Data Science coverage
why_now: Has fresh cash and a CES (January 2027) deadline, and plans to grow its 100k-hour EEG dataset and retrain its brain foundation model before then. Small team, founder-led, so it can decide fast. At the bottom of the size threshold: likely a single 0.5 MW block at most.
